dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Shh, a little lighter on your feet, if you wouldn't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The fish here are used to the quiet, which makes them very sensitive indeed to external noise.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: So, as well as treading gently, we ought to keep our voices down when we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I once tried fishing while two ghosts nearby were chatting incessantly. Didn't get a single bite all day.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Since then, I have resolved to greet any nearby ghosts and ask them to kindly take their conversation elsewhere before I begin.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I very much wish to see fish on the dinner table tonight. I shall not go home empty-handed.
